scope: All source and textual evidence in proof/experiments and proof/progress/receipts, plus named current Picard draft logs/helpers and real-group packaging helper. Includes previously tracked receipts so every unpushed packet is preserved.
excluded: Credentials, .git, toolchains, caches, symlinks and compiled binaries.
proof_status: Preservation snapshot, not a coherent admitted proof release. Frozen receipts retain their own exact scopes; unfinished drafts and in-flight logs are included without claiming success.
